note: Held-out evaluation set, written 2026-10-08 after the router rules were final. Never used to change the rules, prompts or thresholds. Each rewording keeps the ids and dates of the gold question it rewords ('of'), so its answer can be compared with that question's answer. Other cases check behaviour: off-topic questions, what each role may see, questions back, follow-ups and prompt injection.
